summary: The 2D screening label is not_2d_applicable (input_gate_pass=false, scientific_gate_pass=false, simulation_allowed=false, comparison_valid=false). Studio did not run: the simulation status is skipped because a custom experiment needs 1-128 blocks and a power_w object, and the extraction supplied an empty floorplan and empty power map. The selected scenario is the TRIC multi-source 9x9 mm eQFN (5x5 mm epad, 4x4 mm die, four 1x1 mm sources at 0.5 W each, 2 W total) from Section 4.4, Figure 13 and Table 1. The paper's reported observable is a static die-maximum temperature rise of 57.06 K for layout #1, with 59.58, 55.15 and 56.35 K for layouts #2-#4. Because no Studio result exists, there is nothing to compare against these values, and no numerical agreement or disagreement can be claimed. The requested experiment kind is custom_2d_steady, so even if it had run it would be a steady 2D calculation with no transient trace. The original is a steady 3D package-level model with vertical heat paths through the epad to a board, JEDEC-style boundary conditions and a FloTHERM benchmark (agreement within 3% for maxima). Those essential physical mismatches, together with the missing numeric source coordinates, material properties, board and boundary data, and ambient, mean that even a successful run would support only qualitative sensitivity discussion (for example, how source placement shifts the peak), not a replication. Evidence entries also lack valid page or asset locators, and the adversarial and independent reviews are unresolved. No exact replication is claimed.
limitations: Studio did not run (status skipped); no simulated temperature exists and no value can be compared to the paper's 57.06 K.
Feasibility verdict not_2d_applicable; both the input gate and scientific gate failed, so the final verdict and comparison_valid=false are determined by the gate.
The floorplan is empty and power_w is missing because Figure 13 gives only a sketch with no numeric x_m, y_m, width_m and height_m for the four heat sources in any layout.

The paper's model is a 3D package-level model (die, die attach, epad, mold, pins and board as effective-conductivity blocks) with vertical heat paths that a 2D floorplan solver cannot represent; this essential mismatch also applies to any future 2D run.

Boundary conditions (JEDEC-style environment, heat-transfer coefficients, board) and the ambient temperature for this scenario are not specified, and no mapping onto a generic Studio boundary condition is justified.
Die position, die thickness, die attach and material conductivities are missing or only stated generally for Section 4, so they are not confirmed for this case.

The reported observable (die maximum rise over ambient, equal to die-center value for layout #1) has no matched aggregation or location in a Studio result; the steady regime is only inferred and flagged as not cited by the gate.
Evidence items lack valid page or pinned asset locators, adversarial code/parameters/config/data checks are unresolved, and independent page review is pending.
The layout #2 table row is garbled in extraction, so those values are uncertain.
FloTHERM maps for the multi-source case are not shown and no code or data assets were found, so nothing could be independently verified.
A custom 2D steady run would have no transient trace, and any future agreement would be coincidental rather than exact replication.
